title: Quizzes and Flashcards
intro: Self-checks. Progress here measures reading, not merit — nothing in this app implies that spiritual worth can be scored.
editorialNote: Editorial content authored for this app. It has not been through independent scholarly review. See the Content Verification page.

questions.q: Which form is worshipped on the first day of Navratri?
questions.why: Pratipada is Shailaputri, daughter of the mountain.

questions.q: Which form carries a japa mala and a kamandalu?
questions.why: The beads and water pot are the equipment of a student of the spirit — Brahmacharini.

questions.q: Which form holds the infant Skanda on her lap?
questions.why: Skandamata, mother of Skanda.

questions.q: Which of the nine is dark-complexioned and rides a donkey?
questions.why: Kalaratri, on the seventh day.

questions.q: Where does the list of nine names appear?
questions.why: Devi Kavacham verses 3–5 name all nine and state they were declared by Brahma.

questions.q: Which form is associated with the cosmic egg and creative warmth?
questions.why: Kushmanda, on the fourth day.

questions.q: How many chapters does the Durga Saptashati have?
questions.why: Thirteen, in three charitras.

questions.q: Which chapter is the Madhu-Kaitabha narrative?
questions.why: Chapter 1, the whole of the Prathama Charitra.

questions.q: In which chapter does Kali arise to kill Chanda and Munda?
questions.why: Chapter 7. From that episode she is called Chamunda.

questions.q: Which chapter contains the Raktabija episode?
questions.why: Chapter 8, raktabIjavadhaH.

questions.q: The 'Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu' hymn appears in which chapter?
questions.why: Chapter 5, in the dialogue with the messengers.

questions.q: Which chapter is the Narayani Stuti?
questions.why: Chapter 11.

questions.q: What is the traditional verse count of the text?
questions.why: 700, as the source's own colophon states. Our import reconciles to exactly 700.

questions.q: Who receives boons in the final chapter?
questions.why: Chapter 13 closes the frame story with boons to the king and the merchant.

questions.q: According to tradition, how do the Shakti Peethas come to exist?
options: Parts of Sati's body fell at those places
They mark sites of great battles
They are places the Goddess chose in a dream
questions.why: The Daksha-yajna narrative. It is Puranic, not part of the Devi Mahatmya.

questions.q: How many Shakti Peethas are there?
options: It depends on the list — 18, 51, 52, 64 and 108 are all attested
questions.why: The enumerations disagree, and the disagreement is old.

questions.q: Which of these is in Nepal?
questions.why: Guheshwari, beside Pashupatinath in Kathmandu.

questions.q: Kamakhya is on which hill?
questions.why: Nilachal hill, Guwahati.

questions.q: What is worshipped at Jwala Devi?
questions.why: The sanctum has no image; the flames are the object of worship.

questions.q: Is every famous Devi temple a Shakti Peetha?
options: No — the two categories are different and should not be conflated
Only if it is older than 1000 years
questions.why: Meenakshi, Chamundeshwari and Dhakeshwari are great Devi temples and are not universally enumerated as Peethas.
